about.bio: I'm Arun. I build products that feel inevitable once they exist. Right now that means Metzee, a live-auction marketplace where anyone in India can go live, sell and ship in real time. Before that, I spent years in digital marketing, building websites and growing brands through search and social, and earned a Master's in GIS at Sheffield Hallam University. I care about craft, speed and the small details people feel before they notice.

work.title: Swing Analyzer
work.description: A swing-trading app for India and US markets: a nightly plan, live movers, earnings calendar and paper trading, on web and mobile.
work.summary: Swing Analyzer scans the market every night and turns it into a plan for the next session: the market mood, the best setups, and an entry, stop and target for each. During the day it tracks live movers and earnings, and a paper trading desk lets ideas be tested without real money. It covers India (NSE) and US stocks, plus commodities and currencies, and works the same on web and mobile.

work.title: Live trailer alerts
work.description: A JavaScript tool that watches warehouse flow at Amazon and flags full trailers early. Manual monitoring down 30%.
work.summary: In Amazon's Fluid department, trailers were watched by hand to catch the ones filling up. I built a small browser tool in JavaScript that reads live warehouse flow data and raises smart alerts for high-utilisation trailers, so the team can step in before backlogs or missed departures.
